author: CBR
description:
Steven Spielberg’s career changed when he moved from summer blockbusters, like Jaws and Raiders of the Lost Ark, into prestige dramas like The Color Purple and Empire of the Sun.

We break down how Spielberg split his filmography between popcorn spectacles like Jurassic Park and War of the Worlds and heavier award-season films like Schindler’s List and Saving Private Ryan, leading up to ReaI don't dy Player One as one of his last true blockbuster swings.
